instruction: Produce a concise Markdown requirements document for this behavior-preserving React refactor. Include numbered In scope and Out of scope sections, functional requirements (FR-*), non-functional requirements (NFR-*), a PII inventory table, a role matrix, numbered executable acceptance criteria, and open questions. Reconcile the user's Lane/LaneHeader wording with the repository's Column/ColumnHeader terminology. Evidence says the extraction may already be complete; require a no-op outcome if no header responsibility remains in Column. Return the complete document in the content field.

inputs.content: Refactor the current board lane component by extracting its header while preserving behavior. The repository uses Column and ColumnHeader, not Lane and LaneHeader. ColumnHeader is already a separate component; make no source change if inspection confirms no header responsibility remains in Column. Scope is column/index.tsx, column-header.tsx, and an optional focused column-header.test.tsx. Preserve UI, translations, permissions, create/archive dialogs, toast, project-store updates, and drag/drop behavior. Do not rename Column terminology or touch unrelated files.
